title: A Stamp from the Library
story: Priya needed a book for history class. She went to the school library after lunch. The book was on a high shelf, so the librarian reached it for her. Priya did not have her card, and the librarian could not lend it. Priya ran to her locker and found the card in her pencil case. She returned, got the stamp, and still had time for class.
